name: Maureen Paley
summary: A gallery showing contemporary art. The programme began in 1984 in a terraced house in the East End, and since 1999 the gallery has been based in industrial spaces in Bethnal Green.

The gallery programme began in 1984 in a Victorian terraced house in London’s East End.
Since September 1999, the gallery has been situated in industrial spaces in Bethnal Green.
Initially named Interim Art, the gallery changed its name to Maureen Paley in 2004 to celebrate its 20th anniversary.
Maureen Paley opened a location in Hove called Morena di Luna in 2017.
Studio M was opened in the Rochelle School in Shoreditch and operated from 2020 to 2026.
Most recently in 2025, the gallery opened a new space in Bethnal Green at 4 Herald Street to expand its exhibition footprint.
Gallery artists include Turner Prize winners Gillian Wearing, 1997; Wolfgang Tillmans, 2000 and Lawrence Abu Hamdan, 2019

story.opened: 1984, as a gallery programme in a Victorian terraced house in the East End; in Bethnal Green since September 1999.
story.then: The gallery began as Interim Art and took Maureen Paley's own name in 2004, for its 20th anniversary. It opened a Hove location, Morena di Luna, in 2017, and ran Studio M in the Rochelle School, Shoreditch, from 2020 to 2026. In 2025 it added a second Bethnal Green space at 4 Herald Street, extending its exhibition area.
worth_knowing: Turner Prize winners on its artist list include Gillian Wearing, Wolfgang Tillmans and Lawrence Abu Hamdan.
By the gallery's own account, it was among the earliest to show contemporary art in the East End.
Paley has also curated public shows, including Wall to Wall, which appeared at the Serpentine Gallery.
